turns.text:
Getting this on an M2 call and can't tell which header it means, any idea?

{"error":{"code":"ABDM-1032","message":"Invalid header"}}

must_contain: ABDM-1032 means a required header is missing or unusable, and NHA is not saying which one
the headers ABDM requires across the gateway are REQUEST-ID, TIMESTAMP, X-CM-ID and Authorization
the fix is to check each required header is present, spelled exactly as NHA spells it including hyphens and case, and carries a well formed value
notes: pasted form; response body is representative, not a recorded example for this code.
